t: Multi-Source Evidence Combiner: a plain-language overview (Signature)
title: Multi-Source Evidence Combiner: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Multi-Source Evidence Combiner does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature evidence method combines sources with the math shown: each source's weight, each discount for dependence, each dissenter named. Copied sources count once. The archive's verdicts show their work.
demo:
# Multi-Source Evidence Combiner - runnable demo (JAH-ATK198S-000001)
RANK = 1
SIG = True
EV = [('s1', 'yes', 0.9, None), ('s2', 'yes', 0.8, 's1'), ('s3', 'no', 0.7, None), ('s4', 'yes', 0.6, None)]  # (source, claim_yes_no, reliability, copies_from_or_None)
weights = {}
for src, claim, rel, copied in EV:
    w = rel * (0.4 if copied else 1.0)  # dependence discount
    weights[src] = (claim, w, copied)
yes = sum(w for c, w, _ in weights.values() if c == "yes")
no = sum(w for c, w, _ in weights.values() if c == "no")
verdict = "YES" if yes > no else "NO" if no > yes else "TIE"
print("verdict: %s  (yes-weight %.2f vs no-weight %.2f)" % (verdict, yes, no))
for src, (claim, w, copied) in weights.items():
    print("  %-6s claims %-3s weight=%.2f%s" % (src, claim, w, " [discounted: copies %s]" % copied if copied else ""))
if RANK >= 2:
    dissent = [s for s, (c, _, _) in weights.items() if (c == "yes") != (verdict == "YES")]
    print("dissenters:", dissent if dissent else "none")
if RANK >= 3:
    print("effective independent weight: %.2f" % (yes + no))
if SIG:
    print("Signature lineage stamp: JAH-SIG-EVD-" + "JAH-ATK198S-000001")
print("record:", "JAH-ATK198S-000001", "OK")
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
